description: Beam properties of the upright mast along body z for the first bending frequency (roadmap C9, CAD extraction). Frequencies are a reference only.
frames: body frame x forward = Z_cad, y left = X_cad, z up = Y_cad, origin = CAD origin; SI

section_convention.Iy_m4: integral (x - x_c)^2 dA: bending in the x-z plane (fore-aft deflection)
section_convention.Ix_m4: integral (y - y_c)^2 dA: bending in the y-z plane (lateral deflection)
section_convention.principal_angle_deg: angle of the I_max axis from body y towards body x
section_convention.J_m4: Saint-Venant torsion constant (FD Prandtl stress function, closed cells included)
section_convention.centroid: x_c_m, y_c_m: centroid of the structural cut (not the mass centre)
section_convention.stations: cuts at the centres of 50 mm slices; slice mass from exact half-space volumes

list: ASSUMPTION E = 210 GPa, nu = 0.3 (G = 80.8 GPa) for all mast plates (not in the STEP file)
density 7.85 g/cm^3 = STEP material of the mast plates (case C = STEP here)
plates of one segment that touch are welded (continuous section)
segment flanges are bolted and rigid (no joint flexibility); flange and diaphragm plates count as mass only
rack gear bars (995 mm with 5 mm gaps, bolted) and the ladder are mass only
local plates (hinge plates, boss, lugs, gussets, end blocks) count for stiffness where they are cut
hoses, wire rope, oil not in the model (mass 0)

channel.note: bent C channel, rear web + two side flanges (main box)

corner_rail.note: square bar on the front corners; guide rail of the drive shoes

diaphragm.note: transverse diaphragm inside the box; stiffness over its thickness

flange.note: segment end flange (bolted joint), transverse plate; stiffness over its thickness

front_plate.note: front plate closing the channel into a box (main box)

ladder.note: ladder rails, rungs and brackets on the +y side: non-structural, mass only

local.note: welded local plate (hinge plates, boss, lugs, gussets, end blocks)

pin_bush.note: pins, bushes, key plates, space rings: mass only

rack.note: rack gear bars, 995 mm long with 5 mm gaps: mass only

rack_bar.note: bar on the front centre that carries the rack gears

hinge_pin.bushes: BUSH-1 x2, bore R75 / outer R85, body y +-0.110 .. +-0.310
hinge_pin.type: pin about body y: free rotation in the fore-aft plane; the bush pair (span 0.62 m) carries moments about x and z into the boom

backstay.pin_axes: body y (CAD X) at both eyes
backstay.stiffness_note: ASSUMPTION: oil in the cylinder only (hoses, valve block and steel compliance not included -> upper bound); both chambers locked (pilot check valves assumed like the legs; backstay valve not in the circuit drawing)
backstay.equivalent_mass_note: rigid link turning about the lower pin (axial sliding of the rod ignored)

boom_cylinder.note: vertical cylinder; boom roll stiffness = k_cyl * lever^2. Bore not confirmed (face radii listed); hydraulic stiffness unknown

supports.mast_foot: free end at body z -0.649 m with the lower guide; no support to the deck found
supports.mast_top: free end at body z 9.851 m with the top sheave
supports.joint_mast1_mast2: MAST:1 (foot) and MAST-2 meet at flanges (CAD Y 1171) and PIN-2 R30 (body x 2.083, z 1.171); taken as bolted rigid

mast_axis_reference.note: median centroid of the structural cut in MAST-3 (z 3.1..4.3 m)

topsheave.name: topsheave
topsheave.connection: sits on the MAST-5 top flange (CAD Y 9851), bolted (assumed rigid)
topsheave.source: parts_classified.csv rows, case C = STEP densities

winch.name: winch
winch.connection: 4 bolts (R6.9) on the rear of MAST-2 (mast_summary joints)
winch.source: parts_classified.csv rows, case C = STEP densities

lower_guide.name: lower_guide
lower_guide.connection: clamps the rails at the mast foot (FIX PIN, GUIDE PIN); no other support found (cad_mast_review 4)
lower_guide.source: parts_classified.csv rows, case C = STEP densities

backstay_cylinder.name: backstay_cylinder
backstay_cylinder.connection: two-force link boom (lower pin) -> mast lugs (upper pin, PIN-1)

mast_assy_total.name: mast_assy_total
mast_assy_total.connection: MAST ASSY:1 (segments, racks, pins, bushes); distributed in the beam table

auger_connection.guide_shoes: 6 GUID CATCHER (3 per side) wrap the front corner rails; pads: CATCHER PAD-2 on the rail front face (Z_cad 2653 = body x 2.653) and outer side faces (|y| 0.360), CATHCER PAD-1 on the rail rear face -> restrains x and y in both directions; the vertical span of the shoe rows carries moments
auger_connection.vertical: 4 ELEVATION GEAR pinions on the rack (Nabtesco motors) carry the weight
auger_connection.model_hint: rigid body attached to the mast over the shoe span; centre of the span used as one attachment node in the reference estimate

axial_load_info.note: gravity pre-load (P-delta) lowers the bending frequency; not in the estimate

frequency_estimate_reference.warning: reference only (not a verdict); dynamics-expert to verify
frequency_estimate_reference.method: planar Euler-Bernoulli frame FE (50 mm elements, consistent mass, axial dof) and Rayleigh quotient with the static shape under a lateral 1 g load

cases.cantilever: clamped at the hinge height z = 1.371 m, mast above it; drive + tool, top sheave, winch as rigid bodies; backstay ignored
cases.fore_aft_pin_backstay: whole mast incl. foot and lower guide; pin at the hinge point, locked backstay as an axial spring along its axis

checks.integral_A_note: mean area of the 5 mm sub-cuts x slice length x rho vs the B-rep mass of all stiffness solids (incl. flanges, diaphragms)

symmetry.note: structure is symmetric about body y = 0; the ladder (+y side) shifts the mass
